user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my sister's graduation. Fetch the top trending memes from Reddit's r/memes to create a slideshow that will make everyone laugh. Also, check if the username 'graduationparty' is available on Patreon, Shopify, and Soundcloud.

TaskList.description: 查询Reddit的r/memes版块，获取当前最热门的梗图内容，用于制作幻灯片。
根据获取的热门梗图内容，制作幻灯片或图片集，用于派对展示。
检查用户名'graduationparty'在Patreon、Shopify和Soundcloud上的可用性。
